_note: Curated corrections to the `knowledge` and `mechanics` blocks of ability_formulas.json. Those blocks are LLM-estimated during extraction, and a re-extraction would regenerate the same errors, so corrections live here and are folded in by every loader (web/advisor/profiles.py, web/fight_engine.py, scripts/export_engine_data.py). Only add an entry when the extracted value is factually WRONG and the evidence can be stated; every entry needs a reason.

_schema.knowledge: keys merged over the champion's knowledge block (resource, asEfficiency, abilitiesCanCrit, ...)
_schema.removeMechanics: list of mechanic kinds to delete from the champion's mechanics list
_schema.reason: why the extraction is wrong here. Required.
_schema.abilities: per-slot overrides folded into the extracted ability. Supported: damage (REPLACES the slot's damage list wholesale) and empowerLimit (how many following attacks one cast empowers -- read by both engines ahead of the prose heuristic). Requires reason quoting the source text.

Garen.reason: Extraction says resource=mana; Garen has no resource. Base stats carry mana=null and no ability lists a cost. The error was masked by a correct noResource mechanic, but anything reading the resource field directly sees the wrong answer.

Mordekaiser.reason: Extraction says resource=mana; Mordekaiser is manaless (base mana=null, no costs). Unlike Garen he has NO noResource mechanic either, so nothing told the model mana stats are dead on him. 7.2d drift: asEfficiency 0.3 -> 0.2. The 7.2d re-extraction moved this value without the patch touching the champion's attack pattern (asEfficiency 0.3 -> asEfficiency 0.3 -> 0.2); the pre-patch value is what the current builds were judged on. Re-litigate with evidence rather than letting an unrelated patch re-tune it.

Graves.reason: Extraction says resource=none plus a noResource mechanic, and the prompt told the model Graves 'has NO mana'. He has 390 base mana and pays per cast (Q 65/70/75/80) -- wildriftfire and wr-meta agree. The reload/magazine mechanic likely got conflated with resourcelessness.

Nilah.reason: Was 0.2. She is a melee Marksman with a basic-attack-carry pattern whose attacks cleave; her damage is attacks per second. 0.9 matches Kai'Sa's tier.

damage.name: Precision Protocol (per empowered attack, physical part)
Precision Protocol (per empowered attack, true part)

Camille.reason: The scraped Q text carries only the FIRST empowered attack; the recast sentence is missing, so extraction modelled one physical hit and flagged nothing unmodeled. Tencent's hero data (10055): '第一次攻击的1.6秒后，精准礼仪会自动强化下一次普通攻击，将伤害的40%转化为真实伤害' -- one cast empowers TWO attacks, the second converting 40% of its damage to true. ENCODING: the engines charge every per-auto component on every empowered attack (empowerLimit x casts), so the two unequal hits are stored as their PER-ATTACK AVERAGE -- hit1 130-160% AD physical plus hit2 60/40 phys/true averages to 104-128% physical + 26-32% true per empowered attack, exact in total with empowerLimit 2. Writing the hits separately double-counted (each comp rode both empowered attacks). Owner-approved 2026-08-20.

_revertNote: Twisted Fate (asEfficiency 0.8) and Kennen (0.7) corrections were applied on 2026-07-29 and REVERTED the same day on owner meta-judgment: with the raised values the model built Nashor's Tooth as an effective core item on both (slot 2 in consecutive Twisted Fate runs), and neither champion builds it as a staple in the live meta. Their every-N-hit passives are real, but the extraction's 0.2 produces the builds that match reality. If this comes up again, re-litigate with N-run evidence against real meta builds, not from ability text alone.
